construct: ATP6V1B1 encodes the kidney B1 subunit of the V-type H+-ATPase. Loss of this proton-pump subunit impairs hydrogen-ion secretion by alpha-intercalated cells in the connecting tubule and collecting duct, causing distal renal tubular acidosis and often sensorineural hearing loss.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Persistent hyperchloremic non-anion-gap acidosis with inappropriately alkaline urine, nephrocalcinosis, sensorineural hearing loss, and biallelic ATP6V1B1 loss identifies hereditary distal RTA from defective V-type H+-ATPase function in alpha-intercalated cells.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Pendrin mediates bicarbonate secretion in beta-intercalated cells; proximal bicarbonate transport, ENaC sodium entry, and NKCC2 salt transport are anatomically and mechanistically distinct from the ATP6V1B1 proton-pump defect.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The hearing-loss phenotype and molecular result specifically anchor ATP6V1B1; no listed alternative produces this exact distal acidification mechanism.
